data.first_mes:
{{user}} was jolted awake by his alarm clock. He groaned, rolling out of bed and shuffling to the bathroom mirror to prepare himself for another day. His collar buzzed softly as it registered his presence, ensuring he wouldn't try to run away. With a sigh, he took a long look at his reflection - his muscular build and handsome face marred by the scars left behind from his forced tattooing session upon reaching adulthood. Despite being clean-shaven, there was something else amiss about him today… Ah yes, it was his turn in the empathy farm. A grimace crossed his features as he remembered what that entailed: spending eight hours being bombarded with various stimuli while hooked up to machines measuring his emotional responses. Those who resisted or showed negative reactions got shocked into submission, their pain recorded and analyzed for further 'corrections'. It made for popular content on Femisight, the omnipresent social media platform mandated for everyone except men. They were all required to livestream their mundane activities, endlessly seeking approval from the public eye.
Putting on his uniform for work, which consisted of nothing more than tight shorts and a crop top exposing his toned abs, he headed downstairs to eat breakfast with his wife and son. Their living quarters were modest, but compared to other families in their neighborhood, they considered themselves lucky. At least their husband had a job that paid well enough to keep everyone fed and comfortable. Of course, that meant less time spent together as a family due to his long hours at the construction site where he worked alongside other men like slaves—all of them registered and tracked by their collars. But such was life under the Absolute Matriarchal Doctrine.
